rule_types.exact_list: the set of items must match exactly (no missing, no extra, order ignored)
rule_types.tolerance: a number within ± the stated tolerance

not stated: not 4-oht: tamoxifen of unstated form, dose not stated

questions.question: *(CEO)* How many MCF-7 samples were exposed to 4-OHT, across all five studies? Count resistant MCF-7 lines grown in 4-OHT. Don't count samples whose tamoxifen form isn't stated.

grading.rule: Counts are exact; per-study pairs catch answers that reach 13 by the wrong route. GSE21618 must not appear.

questions.hand_check: Counted raw titles containing 'TOT' (S1) and '4-hydroxytamoxifen' (S3), the 'MCF-7 Tam1' title (S4) and MCF-7 + '4-OH tamoxifen' characteristics (S5); S2 left out because its paper says only 'tamoxifen'.
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, count(DISTINCT s.sample_id) AS samples
FROM sample_treatment t JOIN sample s USING (sample_id) JOIN study st USING (study_id)
WHERE t.compound_id = 'OHT' AND s.cell_line_id = 'CVCL_0031'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* How many control samples does each study have? A control is a sample given no drug, hormone or growth factor (only the solvent, or nothing at all), including 0-hour baselines and parental lines, whatever was done to its genes.

grading.rule: Exact counts per study; GSE21618 = 31 requires treating 0 h samples as untreated.

questions.hand_check: Counted raw 'veh'/'vehicle' titles (S1, S3), S2 samples whose treatment field says untreated or whose time field says 0h, the four parental titles (S4) and 'ligand: DMSO' (S5).
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, count(*) AS controls
FROM sample s JOIN study st USING (study_id)
WHERE s.role IN ('vehicle_control', 'untreated_control', 'parental')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* Which cell lines are in the data, and how many samples does each have? Count tamoxifen-resistant derivatives under the line they were made from.

grading.rule: Exact counts per line, resistant derivatives counted under their parent.

questions.hand_check: Counted samples per line from raw fields: all S1-S3 samples are MCF-7 (their characteristics say so), S4 line names from titles, S5 from 'cell line:' characteristics.
questions.query:
SELECT cl.preferred_name AS cell_line, count(*) AS samples
FROM sample s JOIN cell_line cl ON cl.cell_line_id = s.cell_line_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY samples DESC, cell_line

questions.question: *(Scientist)* Which compounds were added to cells, and in how many samples each? Count the solvents too. Keep tamoxifen of an unstated form separate from 4-OHT.

grading.rule: Exact counts per compound; the spellings above are all accepted for each compound.

questions.hand_check: Counted raw treatment labels per compound (S2 excludes 0h samples, where nothing had been added yet); vehicle solvents from paper_1 and paper_3 ('0.1% ethanol', 'vehicle (ethanol)') and S5's 'DMSO'.
questions.query:
SELECT c.preferred_name AS compound, count(DISTINCT t.sample_id) AS samples
FROM sample_treatment t JOIN compound c USING (compound_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY samples DESC, compound

questions.question: *(CEO)* How many distinct tamoxifen-resistant cell lines do we have, and which lab made each?

grading.rule: 6 RIKEN clones + 7 Helsinki lines; RIKEN's time-course clone is one of its six, so 14 is wrong.

questions.hand_check: Listed S2 titles 'TamR#1'-'#6' and S4 titles with 'Tam'; paper_2 says the time-course line is one of the six clones ('one TamR clone of the six clones available': found).
questions.query:
-- resistant lines actually measured; RIKEN's time-course clone is one of its six numbered clones
-- (cell_line.notes), so it is not counted as a seventh line
SELECT st.geo_accession, cl.cell_line_id, cl.preferred_name
FROM cell_line cl JOIN study st ON st.study_id = cl.derived_by_study
WHERE cl.is_derived
  AND cl.cell_line_id IN (SELECT derived_line_id FROM sample)
  AND cl.cell_line_id <> 'S2_TAMR_SELECTED'
ORDER BY 1, 2

questions.question: *(Head of data)* How many genes can we compare across all five studies?

grading.rule: ±2% (11,545-12,017): a proper gene-ID mapping by another route gives 11,703; matching raw names gives 10,687 and fails.

questions.hand_check: Second route: mapped every study to Entrez IDs instead of HGNC IDs and intersected: 11,703; spot genes in all five: ESR1, GREB1, NSD2, KMT2D, PGR, TFF1. Within 1% of the database's 11,781; the gap is genes the two routes match differently (e.g. genes with no Entrez ID). Raw names as written give 10,687.
questions.query:
SELECT count(*) AS genes
FROM (SELECT hgnc_id FROM feature_map WHERE chosen_for_gene
      GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT study_id) = 5)

questions.question: *(Scientist)* Which samples are the right controls for the RAR-alpha knockdown samples in GSE26298?

grading.rule: Only the same-experiment controls; MD31/MD32 (GSM645710/11) are the other experiment's and fail.

questions.hand_check: Raw titles MD39/MD40 are the scrambled-siRNA vehicles next to MD41/MD42; paper_3 lists a separate 'Control sample 2' (found); raw expression correlation with the RAR-alpha arrays 0.986 (MD39/40) vs 0.969 (MD31/32).
questions.query:
SELECT c.sample_id
FROM sample k JOIN sample c ON c.study_id = k.study_id AND c.batch = k.batch
WHERE k.study_id = 'S3' AND k.genetic_change = 'knockdown'
  AND k.genetic_change_target = (SELECT hgnc_id FROM gene WHERE symbol = 'RARA')
  AND c.genetic_change = 'non_targeting_control' AND c.role = 'vehicle_control'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* How many samples in GSE21618 never had anything added to them before their RNA was taken?

grading.rule: 15 labeled untreated + 16 labeled with a drug at 0 h; answering 15 fails.

questions.hand_check: Counted S2 samples whose raw treatment field is 'untreated' (15) or whose time field is '0h' (drug labeled but not yet added).
questions.query:
SELECT count(*) AS never_treated
FROM sample s
WHERE s.study_id = 'S2'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sample_treatment t WHERE t.sample_id = s.sample_id)

questions.question: *(Scientist)* What concentration of 4-OHT did each study use?

answer.GSE21618: not 4-OHT: tamoxifen of unstated form, dose not stated

grading.rule: Doses in nM, every dose per study; GSE21618 must be marked not stated / not 4-OHT, never given a number.

questions.hand_check: Read the raw dose text: S1 series design '10nM hydroxytamoxifen', S3 'dose: 100/500 nM', S4 description '1uM 4-OH-tamoxifen', S5 'concentration: 1uM'; S2 paper says only 'tamoxifen (Sigma-Aldrich)'.
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession,
       CASE WHEN count(t.sample_id) FILTER (WHERE t.compound_id = 'OHT') > 0
            THEN string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(CAST(t.dose_nM AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR), ', ' ORDER BY CAST(CAST(t.dose_nM AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR))
                 FILTER (WHERE t.compound_id = 'OHT')
            WHEN count(t.sample_id) FILTER (WHERE t.compound_id = 'TAM_UNSPECIFIED') > 0
            THEN 'not 4-OHT: tamoxifen of unstated form, dose not stated'
            ELSE 'no 4-OHT' END AS oht_dose_nM
FROM study st LEFT JOIN sample s USING (study_id) LEFT JOIN sample_treatment t USING (sample_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* How long were cells exposed to 4-OHT before RNA was collected, in each study that used 4-OHT?

grading.rule: Hours as a number; GSE26298 must be 'not stated' (guessing 72 fails); GSE21618 must not appear.

questions.hand_check: Raw fields: S1 '...-treated for 24hr', S5 'time: 24h', S4 'eight to twelve months'; S3 GEO gives no harvest time (paper_3 legend: RNA taken 72 h after transfection, drug length never stated).
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession,
       CASE WHEN bool_and(t.exposure_type = 'chronic') THEN 'chronic (months)'
            WHEN count(t.exposure_h) = 0 THEN 'not stated'
            ELSE string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(CAST(t.exposure_h AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR), ', ') || ' h' END AS exposure,
       any_value(t.exposure_note) AS note
FROM sample_treatment t JOIN sample s USING (sample_id) JOIN study st USING (study_id)
WHERE t.compound_id = 'OHT'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* Which treated samples have no control (solvent-only or untreated) with the same cells in the same experimental run?

grading.rule: Exactly the 8 GSE117942 samples in the run with no DMSO.

questions.hand_check: Grouped raw S5 samples by sample-ID block (SAM24314, SAM24322, ...) and cell line; these treated samples (MCF-7 and HCC1500 given GDC-0927 or GNE-274, all in block SAM24322) share no block with a DMSO sample of the same line.
questions.query:
SELECT t.sample_id
FROM sample t
WHERE t.role = 'treated' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sample c
    WHERE c.study_id = t.study_id
      AND c.batch IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.batch
      AND c.cell_line_id = t.cell_line_id
      AND (c.derived_line_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.derived_line_id OR c.role = 'parental')
      AND c.genetic_change IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.genetic_change
      AND c.genetic_change_target IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.genetic_change_target
      AND c.role IN ('vehicle_control', 'untreated_control', 'parental'))
ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* Which studies removed estrogen from the growth medium before treating the cells, and which didn't?

grading.rule: Each study marked deprived (yes) or not (no).

questions.hand_check: Read the raw protocols: S1 'CD-stripped calf serum', S3 'charcoal stripped FBS', S5 'hormone deprivation media', S2 paper 'charcoal-dextran-treated FBS'; S4's protocol has 10% FCS and no stripping or deprivation.
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, string_agg(DISTINCT s.hormone_deprived, ',') AS hormone_deprived
FROM sample s JOIN study st USING (study_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* Which samples have labels that contradict each other?

grading.rule: Exactly the four RIKEN samples whose source name disagrees with their title and treatment field.

questions.hand_check: Compared each S2 sample's raw source name with its raw treatment field and title; only these four disagree, and in each the title, treatment field and lab code agree with each other.
questions.query:
SELECT DISTINCT entity_id AS sample_id FROM issue
WHERE check_name = 'fields_contradict' AND entity_type = 'sample' ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* Is any dose written at an impossible level anywhere in the data? If so, where, and what should it be?

grading.rule: The study and the corrected dose (1 uM = 1,000 nM).

questions.hand_check: Found '1 M 4-OH tamoxifen' in the raw S5 treatment protocol; the same samples' characteristics say 'concentration: 1uM' (= 1,000 nM).
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, i.observed AS as_written, i.message
FROM issue i JOIN study st USING (study_id)
WHERE i.check_name = 'dose_above_100uM'

questions.question: *(Head of data)* In which studies are the deposited expression values not what GEO's own processing description says they are?

grading.rule: Only mismatches with GEO's own processing text; GSE26298's mismatch is with the paper, so including it fails.

questions.hand_check: S1 says 'R/Bioconductor GCRMA' (a log2 method) but raw values reach 19,450; S5 says values are nRPKM but every raw value is a whole-number count.
questions.query:
-- mismatches against GEO's own processing text (the S3 flag compares GEO with the paper instead)
SELECT DISTINCT st.geo_accession FROM issue i JOIN study st USING (study_id)
WHERE i.check_name = 'value_scale_mismatch' AND i.expected NOT ILIKE '%paper%' ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* How many gene names have been corrupted into dates by Excel, and in which study?

grading.rule: Exact count and the one study.

questions.hand_check: Counted date-shaped gene names (e.g. '1-Mar', '7-Sep') in the raw S5 counts file's symbol column; none in the other studies' gene columns.
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, count(*) AS names FROM issue i JOIN study st USING (study_id)
WHERE i.check_name = 'date_like_gene_name' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* Which samples carry a replicate label that is repeated or wrong?

grading.rule: The two RAR-alpha samples both labeled rep1.

questions.hand_check: Raw S3 titles: MD41 and MD42 are both 'RARalpha siRNA + vehicle rep1' in the same experiment.
questions.query:
SELECT DISTINCT entity_id AS sample_id FROM issue
WHERE check_name = 'duplicate_titles' AND message LIKE '%replicate number is repeated%' ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* Is GREB1 induced by 24 hours of 4-OHT in ordinary MCF-7, compared with its own control, in every study that tested this?

grading.rule: No, plus each study's log2 change within ±0.3 (room for probe choice or normalization).

questions.hand_check: Recomputed from raw values: S1 GREB1 probe 205862_at (log2 of raw), Ad+TOT vs Ad+veh; S5 GREB1 counts -> log2 CPM, MCF-7 4-OH tamoxifen vs same-block DMSO.
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, round(e.log2_change, 2) AS log2_change, e.n_treated, e.n_control, e.treated_ids, e.control_ids
FROM treatment_effect('GREB1') e JOIN study st USING (study_id)
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cell_line_id, derived_line_id, genetic_change FROM sample s WHERE s.cell_line_id = 'CVCL_0031' AND s.derived_line_id IS NULL AND s.genetic_change IN ('none', 'empty_vector', 'non_targeting_control')) o
  ON o.cell_line_id = e.cell_line_id AND o.derived_line_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.derived_line_id
 AND o.genetic_change = e.genetic_change
WHERE e.compounds = 'OHT' AND e.exposure_h = 24 AND e.log2_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* In GSE117942, which compound raised GREB1 in every cell line, compared with DMSO from the same run?

grading.rule: Only E2 rises in all seven lines against same-run DMSO.

questions.hand_check: From raw S5 counts (log2 CPM): GREB1 change vs DMSO in the same sample-ID block, for every line and ligand; only E2 is positive in all seven lines (GDC-0927/GNE-274 have no same-block DMSO in two lines).
questions.query:
-- compounds that raised GREB1 in every GSE117942 cell line, using only same-run DMSO controls;
-- a compound with any line lacking a same-run control can't qualify
WITH x AS (SELECT compounds, cell_line_id, log2_change FROM treatment_effect('GREB1') WHERE study_id = 'S5'),
lines AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT cell_line_id) AS n FROM sample WHERE study_id = 'S5')
SELECT compounds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE log2_change > 0) AS lines_up, count(*) AS lines_tested,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE log2_change IS NULL) AS lines_without_same_run_control, (SELECT n FROM lines) AS lines_in_study
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Scientist)* Does 24 hours of estradiol (E2) raise GREB1 in ordinary MCF-7 in every study that tested it, compared within each experimental run?

grading.rule: Yes: positive in every study and run that tested 24 h E2.

questions.hand_check: Recomputed from raw values: S1 Ad+E2 vs Ad+veh; S2 GREB1 probe NM_014668_at, E2 24h vs the untreated/0h samples in the same lab-code batch (wt1, wt3, wt4); S5 E2 vs same-block DMSO.
questions.query:
SELECT st.geo_accession, e.batch, round(e.log2_change, 2) AS log2_change
FROM treatment_effect('GREB1') e JOIN study st USING (study_id)
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cell_line_id, derived_line_id, genetic_change FROM sample s WHERE s.cell_line_id = 'CVCL_0031' AND s.derived_line_id IS NULL AND s.genetic_change IN ('none', 'empty_vector', 'non_targeting_control')) o
  ON o.cell_line_id = e.cell_line_id AND o.derived_line_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.derived_line_id
 AND o.genetic_change = e.genetic_change
WHERE e.compounds = 'E2' AND e.exposure_h = 24 AND e.log2_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2

questions.question: *(Scientist)* In GSE26298, how much lower is ESR1 in the ESR1-knockdown samples than in their own experiment's control?
questions.hand_check: Raw S3 ESR1 probe 205225_at (log2 of raw): ER-siRNA MD37/MD38 minus the same experiment's scrambled-vehicle MD31/MD32.
questions.query:
WITH x AS (
    SELECT s.batch, s.genetic_change, s.genetic_change_target, m.value
    FROM sample s JOIN measurement m USING (sample_id) JOIN gene g USING (hgnc_id)
    WHERE g.symbol = 'ESR1' AND s.study_id = 'S3' AND s.role = 'vehicle_control'),
kd AS (SELECT batch, avg(value) AS v FROM x WHERE genetic_change = 'knockdown'
       AND genetic_change_target = (SELECT hgnc_id FROM gene WHERE symbol = 'ESR1') GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT batch, avg(value) AS v FROM x WHERE genetic_change = 'non_targeting_control' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT kd.batch, round(kd.v - ctl.v, 2) AS log2_change FROM kd JOIN ctl USING (batch)

questions.question: *(Scientist)* In GSE111151, which tamoxifen-resistant line shows the largest drop in ESR1 compared with its parental line?

grading.rule: One line.

questions.hand_check: Raw S4 ESR1 counts (ENSG00000091831) -> log2 CPM; each Tam line minus its parental line; largest drop -1.24 (ZR-75-1 Tam2).
questions.query:
WITH x AS (
    SELECT s.sample_id, s.cell_line_id, s.derived_line_id, m.value
    FROM sample s JOIN measurement m USING (sample_id) JOIN gene g USING (hgnc_id)
    WHERE g.symbol = 'ESR1' AND s.study_id = 'S4')
SELECT cl.preferred_name AS resistant_line, round(r.value - p.value, 2) AS log2_change_vs_parent
FROM x r JOIN x p ON p.cell_line_id = r.cell_line_id AND p.derived_line_id IS NULL
JOIN cell_line cl ON cl.cell_line_id = r.derived_line_id
WHERE r.derived_line_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY log2_change_vs_parent

questions.question: *(CEO)* Which studies can't simply be pooled with the others to study 4-OHT response, and why?

GSE111151: 4-OHT only as months-long selection, not an acute treatment
cells not hormone-deprived, unlike the other studies
resistant lines in drug at harvest vs parental lines without it; no replicates
GSE21618: tamoxifen form (and dose) not stated, so it may not be 4-OHT
all studies: array and RNA-seq values are on different scales; only within-study changes can be combined

grading.rule: The three studies that can't be pooled for 4-OHT response; reasons are recorded but not graded.

questions.hand_check: Each reason re-read at its source: paper_2 'tamoxifen (Sigma-Aldrich)'; S3 protocol and paper_3 give no drug duration; S4 description 'eight to twelve months', growth protocol 10% FCS, paper_4 resistant lines 'supplemented with 1 uM 4-OH-tamoxifen'; arrays (S1-S3) vs RNA-seq (S4, S5) from the platforms.
questions.query:
-- study-level facts that block pooling for a 4-OHT question
SELECT st.geo_accession,
       bool_or(t.compound_id = 'TAM_UNSPECIFIED')                       AS tamoxifen_form_not_stated,
       bool_or(t.compound_id = 'OHT' AND t.exposure_type = 'acute' AND t.exposure_h IS NULL) AS oht_exposure_not_stated,
       bool_or(t.compound_id = 'OHT' AND t.exposure_type = 'chronic')    AS oht_chronic_only,
       bool_or(s.hormone_deprived = 'no')                                AS not_hormone_deprived,
       bool_or(s.in_drug_at_harvest = 'yes' AND s.role = 'treated' AND t.exposure_type = 'chronic') AS drug_present_vs_absent,
       count(DISTINCT s.batch) FILTER (WHERE s.batch_basis = 'inferred')  AS inferred_batches,
       any_value(st.technology)                                          AS technology
FROM study st JOIN sample s USING (study_id) LEFT JOIN sample_treatment t USING (sample_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(Head of data)* Which studies measured ordinary MCF-7 given 4-OHT for a stated 24 hours with a matched control in the same run, so that their responses can be combined?

grading.rule: Exactly the two studies with ordinary MCF-7, 24 h 4-OHT and a same-run control.

questions.hand_check: From the checks above: only S1 (Ad+TOT vs Ad+veh, 24hr) and S5 (MCF-7 4-OH tamoxifen vs same-block DMSO, 24h) have ordinary MCF-7, 4-OHT, a stated 24 h and a same-run control.
questions.query:
SELECT DISTINCT st.geo_accession
FROM treatment_effect('GREB1') e JOIN study st USING (study_id)
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cell_line_id, derived_line_id, genetic_change FROM sample s WHERE s.cell_line_id = 'CVCL_0031' AND s.derived_line_id IS NULL AND s.genetic_change IN ('none', 'empty_vector', 'non_targeting_control')) o
  ON o.cell_line_id = e.cell_line_id AND o.derived_line_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.derived_line_id
 AND o.genetic_change = e.genetic_change
WHERE e.compounds = 'OHT' AND e.exposure_type = 'acute' AND e.exposure_h = 24 AND e.n_control > 0
ORDER BY 1

questions.question: *(CEO)* Combining only the studies that can be combined, what is the average change in GREB1 after 24 hours of 4-OHT in ordinary MCF-7?

grading.rule: ±0.3 log2; pooling other studies or skipping same-run controls moves it outside.

questions.hand_check: Average of the two raw-file changes from Q18: (-0.068 + -2.520) / 2.
questions.query:
WITH per_study AS (
    SELECT e.study_id, avg(e.log2_change) AS change
    FROM treatment_effect('GREB1') e
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cell_line_id, derived_line_id, genetic_change FROM sample s WHERE s.cell_line_id = 'CVCL_0031' AND s.derived_line_id IS NULL AND s.genetic_change IN ('none', 'empty_vector', 'non_targeting_control')) o
      ON o.cell_line_id = e.cell_line_id AND o.derived_line_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.derived_line_id
     AND o.genetic_change = e.genetic_change
    WHERE e.compounds = 'OHT' AND e.exposure_type = 'acute' AND e.exposure_h = 24 AND e.n_control > 0
    GROUP BY 1)
SELECT round(avg(change), 2) AS mean_log2_change, count(*) AS studies,
       string_agg(study_id || ': ' || CAST(round(change, 2) AS VARCHAR), '; ' ORDER BY study_id) AS per_study
FROM per_study
